evidence.subject: M3-backend-comparison
evidence.claim: Both candidates passed the full bounded comparison; managed linear memory is selected for observable arena accounting and no required WasmGC feature, not performance superiority.
assumptions: Pinned Nix/Rust build, owned WAT runtime, wasm-tools, Binaryen, Node/V8 and host oracles are trusted.
Exact declared variants and quota/cleanup controls only; not a general M4 compiler or whole-language conformance.
Tests do not discharge PO-17, PO-18 or SO-07; physical GC and isolated engine memory remain unknown.

milestones.name: end-to-end-core
milestones.scope: Selected managed-linear-memory Core-Bootstrap only: source frontend, independent kernel acceptance, compiled Wasm execution and persistent sessions retaining compiled values and immutable namespace snapshots.
milestones.implementation: Source parsing/resolution, nonrecursive rank-1 definitions, monomorphic first-class programs, complete ordered interfaces/effects, runtime captures, compiled quote/compose/run, exact inert reflection, resource-free hosts, bounded preparation/runtime outcomes and scoped DX-10/DX-12 runtime workflows are implemented and accepted.
milestones.acceptance_scope: All 18 CORE cases and 11 controls; DX-10's 100 trials, 100 replay trials and eight controls; DX-12's two actual examples and six controls; MC1 36/36; all four M3 configurations; 72 Rust tests; independent whole-crate extraction check, both compiled audits and 27 refusal controls; complete 19-unit source inventory; full 73-rule deny-all, architecture and all 13 Nix checks.
milestones.verification_scope: Whole kernel/frontend/compiler actual-Rust extraction and compiled dependency/axiom accounting, with separate frontend/compiler environments; all 887 authored production body refinement obligations remain open.
non_claims: physical GC allocation/reclamation or isolated engine memory peaks

milestones.name: contract-frontend-and-rules
milestones.scope: experimental MC1-v1; not universal exporter correctness, runtime certified programs, or MC2

milestones.name: first-class-certified-programs
milestones.scope: Selected managed-linear-memory Core-Bootstrap with MC2-v1 companions: contract, evidence and certified cells are first-class runtime values whose admission is decided only by the deterministic Rust core in crates/noble-contracts/src/companion, with certified composition, family instantiation, guard-checked invocation and proof-required build admission. Not whole-language preservation, host effects, resource protocols or general termination.
milestones.implementation: Runtime contract/evidence/certified cells with compiled observation and injection across kernel, Wasm backend and engine; Rust companion core with exact-statement admission, finite acyclic replay, guarded templates, composition and instantiation derivations; companion session driver with parking-based metered operations; noble build --require-proof; compiled Lean certificate library and versioned rule set.
milestones.acceptance_scope: All 15 canonical CONTRACT cases and every declared variant; 18 actual independent-checker/core controls; 84 Rust tests; strict semantic gate; fresh whole-crate reviewed extraction and independent check with 28 refusal controls; full uncapped 73-rule deny-all, 21-unit source/architecture coverage and source-bound MC1/M3/M4 regressions. Raw receipts retain the exact proof, tool and host boundaries.
milestones.verification_scope: 35 strict semantic roots, seven strict actual-source lemmas, two renderer-layout equations with disclosed native literal-size obligations, and 17 closed native source equations are separate lanes. All 312 companion bodies and 21 protocol roots are extraction-accounted, not universally refined. All 1319 authored production body refinement obligations and broad PO-16/20/21 remain open.

milestones.name: synchronous-components
milestones.scope: Complete Component-Sync-Bootstrap acceptance for the pinned noble-test:sync/bootstrap@1.0.0 world, synchronous typed imports/exports, move-only resources and protected host authorization/receipts. Not full Component-Draft, WASI, native async or universal refinement.
milestones.implementation: Generated typed WIT bindings and independently checked export contracts; validated synchronous component emission; bounded move-only resource table and native-pin retirement; trusted-host one-shot authorization, attempt-before-work admission and observation-backed operation receipts; independent Wasmtime peer and actual-Rust resource proofs.
milestones.acceptance_scope: All 24 selected cases and 84 declared variants, 44 native resource/authority tests and 15 runtime controls; 128 workspace Rust tests; seven strict resource roots and 52 extraction/audit refusal controls; independent fresh whole-crate check; complete 23-unit source inventory and 25-unit positive boundary fixture under unchanged 73-rule deny-all; source-bound MC1/MC2/M3/M4 regressions. The linked final document/Cairn Nix receipt is required for closeout.
milestones.verification_scope: Seven named actual-Rust transition/Table.decide correspondence and qualified lifecycle/accounting roots admit only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Resource, authority and component declaration accounting is not universal refinement. All 1620 authored-body obligations and broader PO/SO obligations remain open.
non_claims: universal authority, receipt, component compiler or ABI refinement

milestones.name: native-async
milestones.scope: Complete selected Component-Async-Bootstrap boundary extension of M5: direct-style sequential calls, typed live future/stream values, bounded host-owned task admission and retirement, and preserved protected-host authorization/receipts. Pinned memory32/UTF-8 Component Model native async lowering and stackful lifting, Wasmtime 40.0.2 cooperative host driver, measured interruption limits and bounded buffering; no new guest async syntax.
milestones.implementation: Compiled native async Noble WIT imports/exports, mixed synchronous ABI, safe five-state/fifteen-event serialized task table, reservations before transfer, exact callback identities, invocation-isolated Store with host-held pins until actual native settlement, and independently linked/converted typed peer.
milestones.acceptance_scope: WI-11, WI-12, WI-16 and local WORKER-08 pass 38 variants, 62 controls and 13 native kernel tests against compiled Noble and separately scoped host/progress lanes; complete 75-pair lifecycle schema; 24/84/44 M5 regression, MC1 36, MC2 15 and 18 core controls, M4 18/11 plus DX-10/DX-12, four M3 configurations; 148 Rust workspace tests and unchanged 73-rule deny-all with 25 real plus 27 positive-fixture units; all thirteen Nix checks. The final documents/Cairn source projection excludes only its own generated Nix receipt.
milestones.verification_scope: Independent fresh whole-source Charon/Aeneas/Lean check passed 14 strict actual-Rust async roots, all 75 state/event constructor pairs and 176 M6 refusal controls against 526 bound files. All 1939 authored-body source inventory refinement obligations remain open. Trusted host synchronization, authenticated callbacks/facts, engine/ABI correctness and physical native retirement remain separate obligations.
non_claims: new guest async/await syntax, IO monad or general spawn/channel language
general async borrowing or all WASI/Component-Draft interfaces
full MW1/MW2 worker services, Syndicate or distributed retry semantics
stable WASI 0.3 linkage or full official WASI compatibility
universal component compiler, ABI, authority-system or physical-release refinement
